From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: FoamTech — payment channel identity + PO ledger tagging confirmation

Hi Laura —

Thanks for moving quickly on onboarding. Two quick asks from our Payments/FinOps side so we can finish provisioning the payout channel and ensure PO/invoice reconciliation on day one:

1) Bank identity: can you confirm whether FoamTech will be paid to a corporate checking account or a virtual/collection account? If corporate, please confirm ABA and account last 4. If virtual, please confirm the virtual account ID and the remittance reference rules you prefer.

2) PO -> ledger tagging: we need a short mapping so our AP system can attach Redwood PO metadata to your invoices. Typical fields we can write into the remittance/ACH reference are: reference (free text), invoice_id, and custom_tag. Can you confirm which of these you rely on to match invoices to POs on your side? An example CSV is attached for reference.

Attachments: bank-letter-FOAM_20260824.pdf (stub), po-mapping-sample.csv (stub)

Plan: once we have the bank identity and mapping confirmed, Treasury will run a micro-deposit test (ACH) and then we'll mark your account verified. If everything checks, first scheduled payment will be the next cycle on Sept 1.

Appreciate the quick confirmation — planning to follow up tomorrow after Treasury schedules the test.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Operations | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference — Payments & Vendor Onboarding

From: Laura Perkins <laura.perkins@foamtech.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FoamTech — payment channel identity + PO ledger tagging confirmation

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks — attaching our bank letter and W9 now. Answers inline below:

1) Bank identity: FoamTech will receive payments into our corporate operating account (no virtual account).
   - Bank: NorthBridge Bank
   - ABA: 021000021
   - Account name: FoamTech Systems Inc.
   - Account number (ending): ****4321

2) PO -> ledger tagging: Our AP team prefers a consistent Reference string that contains Redwood PO and your internal payment reference. If you can put the Redwood PO in the remittance reference field and the invoice number in InvoiceID (a secondary field), that works best for automated matching. We also support a custom_tag for partner-level segmentation but it is optional.

We would like you to run a micro-deposit before live payments. Once we see the test come through, we'll confirm the amounts and unmask the account for live processing.

Attachments: foamtech_w9.pdf (stub), bank-letter-FOAM_20260824.pdf (stub)

Laura Perkins
Head of Finance | FoamTech Systems
laura.perkins@foamtech.com | +1 (617) 555-3487

Hi Laura — great, thanks for the clear answers and the attachments. Plan below: 

- Treasury will schedule the ACH micro-deposit test tomorrow (Thu 08/26) from our clearing account; expected amounts will be small cents (we'll include the two amounts in the confirmation email).
- We'll place the Redwood PO in the remittance Reference field and the invoice number in InvoiceID, per your preference. We'll also include our internal partner tag in custom_tag for reporting. Sample mapping attached (po-mapping-sample.csv).
- Please confirm that when our Reference field contains both PO and our payment id, FoamTech's matcher will still accept the PO token anywhere in the string (some banks strip special characters).

For vendor onboarding paperwork: I've shared a DocuSign link for the vendor form — if you could have your AP sign it, that will finalize tax/compliance fields in our system: https://www.docusign.com/fofm/vendor-onboarding-FOAM-2026

Attachments: po-mapping-sample.csv (stub)

—Jasmine
Account Operations | Redwood Inference
